messages:
jana (support): Seeing a spike in customer tickets — multiple customers reporting 502/504s and long timeouts on /v1/generate across hosted-prod in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Escalating to war room.
eric (oncall): I'm on it. Noted region/endpoint. Can someone paste quick error examples from logs?
olivia (customer-success): Just forwarded a customer's payload — they hit a 504 after ~10s, then a retry gave 502. They said it started ~10:20 UTC.
maya (eng-sre): I see anomalies on the gateway: increased connection queue length and upstream 5xx rate from inference-pool service around 10:18–10:30 UTC. Correlating with autoscaler spike.
eric (oncall): Deploy-bot, roll history for inference-pool last hour?
deploy-bot: Recent deploys: inference-pool v2.17.4 at 10:05 UTC, config change: MAX_CONN_PER_WORKER lowered from 1000 to 600 (hotfix). No rollbacks.
liam (platform): That config change was intended to reduce memory pressure on smaller SKUs. Paging @maya @eric — maybe the lower MAX_CONN caused earlier eviction and more frequent cold starts.
maya (eng-sre): Agreed. Gateway started returning 502 when upstream returned ECONNRESET. Sample gateway log: 
```
[10:21:43] gateway: upstream response error: read tcp 10.0.5.12:443->10.0.9.73:54321: read: connection reset by peer
[10:21:43] gateway: returning 502 to client
```
Looks like workers are dropping connections under load.
eric (oncall): Immediate mitigation: revert MAX_CONN_PER_WORKER to 1000 on hosted-prod pools and scale up worker count by +20% for affected pools. @liam can you push?
liam (platform): Rolling config revert to inference-pool in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 now. Also bumping desired replicas +20% in those zones. Expect ~90s to config rollout.
maya (eng-sre): Adding temporary circuit-breaker at gateway to reduce concurrent requests to any single upstream worker. Also enable fallback routing to smaller model-variant (cpu-safe) after 3s of backend stall.
eric (oncall): Good. Also enabling 200ms extra timeout on proxy retry to prefer quick failover.
olivia (customer-success): I'll notify impacted customers that we're mitigating and will follow up with root cause and ETA.
jana (support): Adding a few repro payloads to the incident ticket: one that consistently produced 504 for customer A. Repro steps: 
1) POST /v1/generate with model: redwood-7b-hosted, seq_len:512, batch_size:1, prompt ~600 tokens.
2) Observe 504 after 10s.
3) Retry -> 502.
Commands used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-hosted","prompt":"<...>","max_tokens":256}' -v
```
eric (oncall): After liam's rollback completes, watch error rate. If still high, we may need to temporarily re-route traffic to Dedicated pools for top customers.
liam (platform): Revert finished at 10:24:12 UTC for us-west-2; replicas increased. eu-west-1 at 10:25:05 UTC. Early metrics: upstream 5xx count dropping in us-west-2.
maya (eng-sre): Confirmed: 5xx rate in us-west-2 back to baseline by 10:28. eu-west-1 plateaued then decreased by 10:32. Gateway queue length returning to normal.
olivia (customer-success): I just messaged the customers and they confirmed degraded behavior improved. They appreciated live updates. :thumbsup:
eric (oncall): Marking incident mitigated at 10:33 UTC. Keeping war room open for postmortem items.
jana (support): Adding tickets label "incident-1865002222" and linking this thread.
maya (eng-sre): Root cause hypothesis: config change (MAX_CONN_PER_WORKER=600) combined with a workload distribution shift (longer sequences, more KV cache usage) caused worker process to hit connection pressure and drop upstream connections -> gateway returned 502/504. Secondary factor: autoscaler reacting to CPU signals too slowly, leading to transient undersizing.
liam (platform): Action items (short-term): 1) Revert in prod (done). 2) Add safety check to config rollouts to block MAX_CONN reductions below threshold when traffic > X rps. Owner: liam. ETA: 48h.
maya (eng-sre): Action items (short-term): 1) Improve autoscaler signals to consider queue length and average response latency, not just CPU. Owner: maya. ETA: 72h. 2) Add circuit-breaker default in gateway config for upstream connection resets. Owner: maya. ETA: 24h for prod toggle.
eric (oncall): Action items (support/CS): 1) Pre-approved template for customer notifications during 5xx/timeouts. Owner: olivia/jana. ETA: 24h.
jana (support): Also add the reproducible prompt examples to the internal eval bench so we can detect regressions in future deploys. Owner: jana. ETA: 48h.
liam (platform): Longer-term: automated rollout guardrails — model of the rollout that simulates connection usage and rate-limits config changes. Owner: liam + eng-reliability. ETA: 3 weeks.
maya (eng-sre): Postmortem plan: I will draft a blameless postmortem with timeline, cause, impact (customer list + errors), and detailed action items. Posting an initial draft by EOD tomorrow.
eric (oncall): Schedule follow-up review with product & docs to update runbooks and release checklist. Meeting invite for 48h.
olivia (customer-success): Will follow up with customers with root cause summary once postmortem is ready.
az-bot: Incident analytics snapshot: affected requests peaked at 4.7k rps aggregated across regions; top affected customers: 6 paying accounts.
liam (platform): Note: we should also add synthetic slo checks that validate tail latency request/response across model variants. Owner: liam. ETA: 7 days.
maya (eng-sre): Closing war room, keeping thread open for updates and the postmortem link.
eric (oncall): Thanks everyone. Quick recap of owners and ETA in thread is enough — we'll track in the action-items board. :white_check_mark:
